posting.description:
Position Name: Data Quality Engineer
Reports to: Data Team Lead
Location/Type: Ukraine Remotely
Working hours: 10 AM — 7 PM UA
 
Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown 100% year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.
We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. At Atlas Technica, we offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and great perks to our global Team. We strive to maintain a professional yet friendly environment while promoting professional and career development for our Team Members. Join Atlas Technica now!
As the first dedicated Data QA Engineer on the team, you will establish and drive QA processes, testing standards, and quality controls across our ETL, Data Warehouse, Power BI, and Embedded Reporting solutions.
 
Responsibilities:
· Define and implement QA processes, testing standards, and quality gates for Data & BI projects.
· Design and execute test plans for ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse solutions, Power BI reports, and Power BI Embedded reporting solutions.
· Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and business logic across source systems, ETL processes, semantic models, and reporting layers.
· Perform source-to-target validation, data reconciliation, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
· Test Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX calculations, and Power Query transformations.
· Validate complex KPIs, business metrics, calculations, aggregations, and reporting logic to ensure consistency with business requirements and expected outcomes.
· Validate embedded reporting functionality, Row-Level Security (RLS), customer data isolation, and access controls.
· Investigate data quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and work with developers to resolve defects.
· Collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, and business stakeholders to improve overall data quality and release readiness.
· Participate in requirements reviews, solution design discussions, and data model validation activities to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle.
· Create and maintain test documentation, test cases, defect reports, QA metrics, and testing procedures.
· Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote quality-first practices across the team.
 
Requirements:
· English level — B2 or higher.
· 3+ years of experience in Data QA, ETL Testing, Data Warehouse Testing, or BI Testing.
· 5+ years of total QA experience, including Software QA, Automation QA, Data QA, or related quality-focused roles.
· Experience establishing QA processes, test strategies, and testing practices.
· Strong SQL skills with the ability to create complex validation and reconciliation queries.
· Experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration processes.
· Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).
· Experience testing Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX calculations, and dashboards.
· Experience testing Power BI Embedded or other customer-facing analytics solutions.
· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
 
Desirable Qualities:
· Experience validating historical data models and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD).
· Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps.
· Understanding of data monitoring and freshness validation.
· Knowledge of Power BI REST APIs, report lineage, and metadata validation.
· Experience with performance, scalability, and security testing of analytics solutions.
· Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
· Microsoft Azure, Power BI, Data Engineering, or QA certifications.
 
Atlas Technica is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunit

posting.description:
Platforms: App Store and Google Play
Engagement type: consulting, part-time or project-based
We’re looking for an ASO/ASA Specialist to drive organic growth and visibility for our mobile app on both the App Store and Google Play, working with us as a consultant. You’ll work on a single product across two platforms. You’ll own the full cycle: market analysis → hypothesis → testing → insights → implementation.
You’ll find growth opportunities on your own and test hypotheses with data. You’ll also give the team clear recommendations that move key product metrics.

What you’ll be doing:
Audit the app’s current state on the App Store and Google Play, then build an ASO strategy for both platforms.
Write and optimize text metadata (Title, Subtitle, Keywords, Promotional Text, Short/Long Description) based on keyword research and performance analysis.
Set up, run and optimize Apple Search Ads (Apple Ads) campaigns. This covers keyword discovery, bidding, performance analysis and connecting paid results to organic growth.
Use incentivized traffic to test and boost ASO hypotheses.
Write briefs for designers to create and improve ASO creatives: icons, screenshots, videos and promo assets.
Run A/B tests on metadata and graphics using Google Play Experiments and App Store Product Page Optimization.
Work with Custom Store Listings (Google Play) and Custom Product Pages (App Store).
Improve store listing conversion on both platforms.
Manage ratings and reputation. This means running an in-app review prompt strategy, working with user reviews and tracking sentiment.
Analyze competitors, the market and App Store and Google Play trends to find new opportunities and approaches.
Make sure all assets pass review and comply with Apple and Google guidelines.
Track key ASO/ASA metrics, prepare reports and present results with recommendations for next steps.
Work with project managers and the team to implement ASO initiatives.

Requirements:
2+ years of ASO experience, with hands-on work on both the App Store and Google Play.
Hands-on experience with Apple Search Ads (Apple Ads).
Full-cycle ASO experience: market analysis, strategy, implementation and measuring impact on metrics.
Strong understanding of ranking factors and what drives organic growth on both platforms.
Independent, proactive and accountable for results.

Nice to have:
ASO experience with mental health/lifestyle/health&fitness apps or other highly competitive verticals.
Experience with In-App Events (App Store) and Promotional Content (Google Play).
Organic growth case studies you can share.
